# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 13 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_013_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 13

**13:1** In Mary's sixth month, Joseph came home from the building sites. He walked through the door and stopped dead. She was pregnant. He slapped his own face in anguish, threw himself on the ground in the sackcloth, and sobbed. "How am I going to face the Lord God?" he cried. "What do I say? I brought this girl home from the temple — she was a virgin in God's keeping — and I failed to protect her. Who did this to me? Who set this trap in my own house? Who violated her? Is this the story of Adam all over again? Adam stepped away during his prayers, the serpent found Eve alone and deceived her — and now the same thing has happened to me."

**13:2** He pulled himself together and called for Mary. "What have you done?" he demanded. "You were raised in God's holy sanctuary. An angel fed you with his own hands. And now this — have you completely forgotten God?"

**13:3** Mary burst into tears. "I am innocent. I have never been with a man."

**13:4** "Then explain this," Joseph said. "Where did this child come from?"

**13:5** "I swear before the living God," she said, "I don't know."
